ObservationValidityInterval.semantics: Calendar interval during which the observation, survey or published dataset is authorized for use

GeologicAgeInterval.semantics: Age applicability of the geological unit, event or parameter, measured before present
GeologicAgeInterval.scaleRequirement: request and evidence authority/version must match exactly unless a separately validated conversion exists

ModelApplicabilityRecord.semantics: Explicit decision binding both temporal checks to evidence and a model request
ModelApplicabilityRecord.prohibition: May not replace either source interval or infer one temporal type from the other
